name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 5 – Am 50
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 5a. Strongly condemns the lack of transparency at the highest levels of the European Commission, notably in relation to President Ursula von der Leyen and Pfizergate; recalls the 2025 CJEU judgment finding a breach of EU transparency rules regarding access to text messages linked to COVID-19 vaccine negotiations; calls on the Commission to ensure full transparency in COVID-19 vaccine procurement by disclosing all relevant communications without undue delay; notes the ongoing investigation of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office and calls for its swift and transparent conclusion;
